n73b0eee022.headline: Public debt placed by Angola jumps 56% in one week
n73b0eee022.summary: Angola's central bank placed significantly more public debt on the primary market between August 14 and 18, with issuance rising 56% in one week.
n73b0eee022.why: Public debt issuance levels reflect government financing needs and can impact bond markets and investor sentiment in Angola.

n5e2b165cd0.headline: Minimum wage will rise to a record, government confirmed. Companies want politicians not to decide next time | Aktuálně.cz
n5e2b165cd0.summary: The Czech government confirmed a rise in the minimum wage to 12,200 crowns per month, a new record level.
n5e2b165cd0.why: Minimum wage changes affect labor costs, consumer spending, and inflation, impacting companies and the broader economy in the Czech Republic.
